title: Site
headline: Your local sites, in one place.
description: Keep your frontend projects here. Each has its own process, preview window and port.
restartDesktop: Quit and reopen Aura Desktop to connect folder selection and project execution.
openDesktop: Open this page in the desktop app to choose a folder and run a frontend project.
addFirst: Add a folder to get started
portHelp: Recognized development servers find an available port starting from the default. Multiple projects can run at once.
autoPreview: Running the script opens a separate preview window automatically.
previewWillOpen: Preview opens when the service is ready
selectHint: Add or select a frontend project from the list to start a local preview.
openFailed: Could not open the site address.
previewCount_one: {{count, number}} project with its own preview
previewCount_other: {{count, number}} projects with their own previews
chooseFailed: Could not select the project folder.
processExited: The project process exited unexpectedly. Check the output before running it again.
processExitCode: The project exited with code {{exitCode}}. Check the output; if another process took the port, run the project again.
processExitSignal: The project exited with signal {{signal}}. Check the output before running it again.
previewOpened: Project started and the preview window is open.
previewFailed: Could not open the preview. Check the project output and preview address, then open the preview manually.
previewTimeout: The command is still running, but a working preview port owned by this process could not be confirmed. Check the output, listening address and port, then stop and retry. Other services will not be opened. Port ownership checks require system process tools.
portOccupied: Port {{port}} is occupied. The custom script cannot safely change ports automatically. Update both the script’s listening port and preview address, or stop the occupying service yourself before retrying. Aura will not stop other services.
noFreePort: No free port was found starting at {{port}}. Change the preview address and try again.
portChanged: Port {{preferred}} was occupied. Available port {{port}} was selected automatically.
addressChanged: The development server’s actual address is {{url}} (previously {{previous}}).
directoryAbsolute: The project folder must be an absolute local path.
directoryMissing: The project folder could not be found.
manifestUnavailable: This folder has no readable package.json.
manifestInvalid: package.json must contain a JSON object.
scriptMissing: The selected startup script no longer exists. Select the folder again.
invalidPreviewUrl: The preview address must be a valid local HTTP(S) URL without a username or password.
previewNotReady: The preview is not ready or its port no longer belongs to this project. Stop and run it again.
